lines: [excited, amazed, high energy] ChatGPT gets about TWO and a HALF BILLION questions [short pause] a DAY.
[dropping to a playful secret] Let's follow... [short pause] just ONE.
[curious, like typing it yourself] So, [short pause] can I eat PIZZA for BREAKFAST? [pause] [cheerful, clearly] SEND!
[a bit hushed, sneaking inside] Your words become [short pause] ONES and ZEROS.
[curious, building] The phone's BRAIN [short pause] packs them up,
[excited] and the ANTENNA [short pause] fires them OUT!
[fast, racing, thrilled] Zap! [short pause] To a TOWER, [short pause] down a cable of LIGHT, [short pause] into a building full of COMPUTERS.
[fun teacher mode] Computers only understand NUMBERS,
[playful, smiling] so your question gets CHOPPED into little LEGO bricks, [short pause] each with a NUMBER.
[curious] Then, [short pause] it reads ALL the words TOGETHER.
[thinking out loud] Pizza, [short pause] plus breakfast... [pause] [silly] a map to a pizza shop? [pause] [laughing] Nope! [short pause] A FOOD question.
[slower, building suspense] Here's the SURPRISE: [pause] it DOESN'T look the answer up.
[clear, explaining] It writes ONE word at a time, [short pause] always guessing the most likely NEXT word.
[playful, sing-song] Like: [short pause] twinkle, twinkle, little...
[triumphant] Star! [pause] [amazed] It learned that by reading a GIGANTIC pile of TEXT.
[fast, excited] Then, [short pause] the answer ZOOMS all the way BACK!
[friendly, playful reply] Technically, YES! [pause] Just maybe add some FRUIT.
[satisfied, impressed] All of that, [short pause] in about TWO SECONDS.
[slower, warm, a little amazed] It just did that FOR YOU... [short pause] and about two and a half BILLION more times TODAY.
[deadpan, dry] And it has NEVER once tasted a pizza.
